What is the exact value of $\tan\left(15^\circ\right)$?

*Hint:* Use the fact that $15^\circ = 150^\circ - 135^\circ$.

What is the exact value of $\tan\left(\frac{5\pi}{12}\right)$?

*Hint:* Use the fact that $\frac{5\pi}{12} = \frac{\pi}{4} + \frac{\pi}{6}$.

What is the exact value of $\tan\left(285^\circ\right)$?

*Hint:* Use the fact that $285^\circ = 240^\circ + 45^\circ$.
